practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (DT) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
factors: Season-ending Injured Reserve — ineligible to return this season
practiceReport.beatComment: Lions DT Skyler Gill-Howard is out for the season after suffering a knee injury on a goal line offensive rep last week vs the Bucs.

practiceReport.name: Chuck Clark
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (10th NFL season, 91% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.
factors: Did Not Participate (DNP) on Wednesday (veteran maintenance profile, awaiting Thursday workload)
practiceReport.beatComment: Clark was able to play every defensive snap during Sunday's 31-21 win over the Buccaneers, notching eight total tackles (two solo), including 1.0 sacks, and a pass defensed. The safety may have picked up a hamstring injury during the game, and he will have two more chances to return to practice before Thursday's matchup with the Bears.

practiceReport.name: DJ Wonnum
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (LB) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
factors: Did Not Participate (DNP) on Wednesday (veteran maintenance profile, awaiting Thursday workload)
practiceReport.beatComment: Wonnum registered five solo tackles, including 1.0 sacks, while also adding a pass defensed and a forced fumble during Sunday's 31-21 win over the Buccaneers. The defensive lineman may have picked up a back injury during the contest, and he will have two more chances to return to practice prior to Thursday's matchup with the Bears.

practiceReport.name: Sam LaPorta
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (89% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
factors: Wednesday Limited Participation (LP); player toughness prior = 82%
practiceReport.beatComment: With a Thanksgiving matchup on tap against the Bears, the Lions are easing into the week following Sunday's 31-21 win against the Buccaneers, when LaPorta gathered in three of six targets for 62 yards. He's nursing an ankle issue in the wake of that contest, and he may need to be listed as full Tuesday and/or Wednesday in order to avoid a designation ahead of Thursday's game.

practiceReport.name: D.J. Reed
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (9th NFL season, 94% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.
practiceReport.beatComment: Reed appears to be on track to return to action Thursday against the Bears after missing three straight games with a hip injury. The cornerback will have two more chances to officially practice ahead of Week 12.

practiceReport.name: Khalil Dorsey
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (CB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: Dorsey hurt his wrist early in Sunday's game and was initially deemed questionable to return. The veteran cornerback has since been able to re-enter the game, albeit with a club over the hand that he injured. Dorsey has been working in a rotational role at cornerback, logging a defensive snap share between 32 and 38 percent three straight weeks.

practiceReport.name: Tyler Lacy
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Trench/box position (DT) — historically higher active rate through braced upper-body & ankle soreness (81% baseline).
practiceReport.beatComment: Lacy was limited in practice all week due to a shoulder injury, but he's been cleared to play in Sunday's home game. He's expected to take on an elevated role at defensive end in the absence of Aidan Hutchinson, who is out for the rest of the season due to a torn ACL. Lacy has accumulated 12 tackles (four solo) through nine regular-season games.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Cade Mays
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Mays missed the Lions' two prior games due to an ankle injury that he sustained against the Vikings in Week 8. His placement on IR means he's required to miss at least the next four games, so the earliest he can return is Week 15 against Minnesota. Juice Scruggs figures to be the Lions' starting center for as long as Mays is sidelined.
